title: All-Nutrient Keratin-Glaze Demi Developer
description: Lograr el final profesional con un desarrollador diseñado para respetar la integridad de cada hilo. El All Nutrient Keratint Color-Glaze Demi Developer No Lift es una fórmula de alto rendimiento, estabilizada específicamente diseñada para ser emparejado con Keratint Color Glaze para resultados sin costuras y sin cero.
description_en: Achieve the ultimate professional finish with a developer designed to respect the integrity of every strand. The All Nutrient Keratint Color-Glaze Demi Developer No Lift is a high-performance, stabilized formula specifically engineered to be paired with Keratint Color Glaze for seamless, zero-lift results.
description_full_en: 8.4 oz, Achieve the ultimate professional finish with a developer designed to respect the integrity of every strand. The All Nutrient Keratint Color-Glaze Demi Developer No Lift is a high-performance, stabilized formula specifically engineered to be paired with Keratint Color Glaze for seamless, zero-lift results. Unlike standard developers that can inadvertently "bump" the natural base of the hair, this "No Lift" version ensures that you are only depositing rich, vibrant pigment. It is the perfect tool for the stylist or home enthusiast looking to refresh faded ends, tone pre-lightened highlights to perfection, or perform a clear gloss service that leaves the hair looking like a sheet of glass.The beauty of this developer lies in its Thixotropic properties, which give the final mixture a luxurious, gel-like consistency that glides onto the hair without "drag" or messy dripping. This unique texture allows for pinpoint accuracy during bottle applications or traditional bowl-and-brush techniques, ensuring every cuticle is evenly saturated with All Nutrient's signature Micro-Protein System. Infused with keratin proteins and essential fatty acids, the developer doesn't just act as a catalyst for color; it functions as a reconstructive treatment. As the color deposits, the formula works to fill in porous areas of the hair shaft, resulting in a finished look that feels noticeably stronger, smoother, and more resilient.What truly sets All Nutrient apart is their commitment to clean, organic-based beauty that doesn't compromise on professional-grade power. This 100% vegan formula is free from sulfates, parabens, and gluten, utilizing a corn-derived substitute for petroleum-based glycols to minimize the risk of scalp irritation. The 8.4 oz size is ideal for those who want a reliable, professional-grade developer that fits easily into a compact storage space while still providing enough volume for multiple services. It’s a quirky, eco-conscious choice for anyone who believes that hair color should be as much about health and nourishment as it is about aesthetic transformation.True Zero-Lift Technology: Specifically formulated to provide maximum pigment deposition without altering or "lifting" the natural hair color. This makes it an essential tool for precise toning, color balancing, and refreshing previously colored hair without creating unwanted warmth at the roots.Thixotropic Gel Consistency: The formula features advanced thixotropic properties that allow the mixed color to glide effortlessly onto the hair. This ensures a smooth application with no drag, providing uniform saturation for consistent, blotch-free results every time you style.Protein-Enriched Reconstruction: Enriched with a nutritive-rich system of Keratin and Quinoa, this developer strengthens the hair fiber while it processes. It effectively increases protein levels in the hair shaft, leaving the hair feeling healthier and more durable after the coloring process is complete.Organic-Based Safety Profile: Utilizing Zemea, a corn-based substitute for petroleum-based glycols, the formula is designed to be hypo-allergenic and gentle on the scalp. It provides a safer, more comfortable experience for those with sensitivities while maintaining the high-performance standards of a professional salon.Long-Lasting Fade Resistance: When paired with Keratint Color Glaze, this developer helps lock in the "Maximum Pigment System" for deep color saturation. The result is a vibrant, multi-dimensional hue that resists fading and maintains its brilliant shine for weeks after the initial application.

The final result is a dramatically smoother surface that reflects light and delivers a polished, healthy look and feel.The versatility of this product is what makes it a must-have in your hair care arsenal. It can be used as a targeted treatment to seal your ends after any color service or simply to fortify the lower two to three inches of your hair to maximize length retention. By infusing the hair with vital moisture and essential nutrients, this cruelty-free solution ensures your hair remains smooth, frizz-free, and incredibly radiant, offering a healthy foundation that truly lasts. Beyond the instant fix, this innovative formula provides a powerful defensive shield against future damage. A rich Brazilian Super Nutrient Complex, which includes powerful antioxidants like Açaí Berry Extract, surrounds each strand with a protective heat-activated coating. This barrier dramatically reduces future breakage and defends your hair against the relentless stresses of daily styling, including hot tools and mechanical damage. By strengthening and fortifying weakened areas, the treatment helps defend against cuticle cracking before tears can even begin, ensuring your precision haircuts maintain their sharp shape and structure for up to four weeks between appointments. This process delivers an immediate, visible transformation to a smoother surface, effectively repairing and unifying fractured hair to extend the longevity of your haircut. Advanced Breakage Prevention: The treatment incorporates a Brazilian Super Nutrient Complex containing potent ingredients like Açaí Berry Extract, which surrounds each strand with a powerful, protective layer. This heat-activated coating dramatically reduces future breakage, safeguarding your hair from mechanical damage, hot tool styling, and environmental stressors. When used as a cutting lotion, it reduces blade friction, allowing for optimal precision and helping to preserve the shape of your precision cuts for up to four weeks. Ideal for Hair Length Retention: Recommended specifically for clients who are actively trying to retain or grow their hair length, this targeted solution fortifies the weakest part of your hair—the ends—to prevent tears before they begin. description_full_en: 6.76 oz, Take command of your scalp health with a medicated solution that bridges the gap between clinical efficacy and everyday hair care. The Rohto Mentholatum Selsun Blue Anti-Dandruff Shampoo is a high-performance treatment specifically formulated with 1% Selenium Sulfide, a doctor-recommended active ingredient that targets the root fungal causes of dandruff rather than just washing away the surface flakes. This "Regular" variant is engineered to bring peace to an angry, itchy scalp, working diligently to suppress the recurrence of seborrheic dermatitis and stubborn flaking while leaving your hair feeling remarkably clean and weightless.The secret to Selsun Blue's cult-favorite status lies in its ability to balance intense purification with a refreshing sensory experience. Infused with a cooling hint of menthol, it provides an immediate "tingle" upon application that soothes irritation and calms the heat of a stressed scalp. Unlike traditional medicated shampoos that can leave hair feeling like straw, this refined formula features advanced conditioning agents that respect your hair's natural texture. It builds into a rich, substantial lather that penetrates deep into the follicle to lift away excess sebum and environmental pollutants, ensuring your hair isn't just flake-free, but visibly revitalized and full of natural movement. Designed for both men and women, this shampoo is a versatile staple that fits seamlessly into any grooming ritual. It delivers a crisp, clean scent that neutralizes the clinical aroma often associated with dandruff treatments, allowing you to walk away from the shower with a subtle, healthy fragrance. For best results, use it just twice a week to maintain a balanced "scalp ecosystem" and prevent the return of winter dryness or oily buildup. It’s more than a shampoo; it’s a reliable guardian for your confidence, ensuring that your dark clothes remain flake-free and your scalp feels as healthy as it looks. Targeted Selenium Sulfide (1%): Contains a pharmaceutical-grade concentration of Selenium Sulfide to effectively kill the fungus responsible for dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis. This proactive approach treats the biological source of flaking, ensuring long-term scalp clarity and comfort with regular use. Instant Menthol Cooling: Infused with refreshing menthol to provide an immediate cooling sensation that relieves the stinging and itching associated with scalp inflammation. It acts as a soothing "reset" for irritated skin, making your morning shower a restorative treatment for both hair and mind. Anti-Recurrence Technology: Specifically engineered to create a protective environment on the scalp that prevents the return of scales and itching. description: Tamaño : 25,4 oz, Goldwell New Blonde es un producto exclusivo de salón revolucionario que no sólo crea puntos destacados mezclados de aspecto natural, sino que también ofrece una solución para el crecimiento entre los servicios de resaltado - más, funciona en sólo 5 minutos!

Any client with over 50% highlights. Any client with a base level of 5-9. Clients who desire a natural, soft highlight contrast Using Goldwell New Blonde in combination with highlighting service: Softens the base level between the highlight sections. Contrasts are softened - for an unbeatable natural blonde Using Goldwell New Blonde Highlight in-between highlighting services: Softens the base level at the regrowth. The regrowth becomes less noticable - for a soft transition into the mid-lengths and ends -GOLDWELL NEW BLONDE Base Lifting Cream, 60 mL tube (approx. 2 applications) -GOLDWELL NEW BLONDE Lotion, 750 mL (approx. 24 applications) FAQs: What happens if you let New Blonde process for longer than 5 minutes? If processed for longer than 5 minutes, color results could become brassy and/or golden. What is the extent of damage with New Blonde compared to other lighteners? Hair is significantly less stressed with New Blonde compared to any other lightening processes such as highlifting or lightening. Does it make a difference if highlights for the Full-Service are done with a lightener or highlift color? No, New Blonde can be used in combination with a lightener as well as highlifted highlights. Will hair get lighter with time? New Blonde may influence the amount of highlights needed as regrowth will be lighter, you may simply need fewer highlights. If blonde becomes too light you can easily create darker contrasts with Colorance Lowlights. Can I apply Colorance Blonde Toning after New Blonde? Yes, if needed, you can apply Colorance Blonde Toning. When doing a Full Service application, can I also apply New Blonde before the highlighting service? Yes, New Blonde can be applied before or after highlighting. If you do it after, the process is shorter because New Blonde can be applied directly onto towel-dried hair TIP FOR FIRST TIME USAGE: For new clients, the first New Blonde application should be applied at the regrowth AND mid-lengths and ends, for a full head application. For every following appointment use New Blonde at the regrowth only. TIP FOR HIGHLIGHT RECHARGE SERVICE: For best results, regrowth needs to be no larger than 1/2 inch in length. If larger than 1/2 inch, a Full Service is recommended Mixing ratio: 1:1 - 30 mL New Blonde Lotion + 30 mL New Blonde Base Lifting Cream Application: -New Blonde Full Service 1.) Highlight as usual. Due to easy and fast application, we recommend applying it onto towel-dried hair). For fast application use a large brush and broad sections (approx. 1 inch). 3.)Process for 5 minutes only - do not exceed ! 4.) Shampoo with colorglow[IQ] Color Cleanse Shampoo and condition with colorglow[IQ] Color Neutralize Conditioner. Then finish with appropriate colorglow[IQ] Color Finish Serum. -New Blonde Highlight Recharge Service 1.) Shampoo hair when necessary, to remove styling residue. 2.) Apply New Blonde directly at the shampoo bowl onto towel-dried hair (New Blonde can be applied to dry or towel-dried hair. Due to easy and fast application, we recommend applying it onto towel-dried hair). For fast application use a large brush and broad sections (approx. 1 inch). 3.)Process for 5 minutes only - do not exceed ! 4.) Shampoo with colorglow[IQ] Color Cleanse Shampoo and condition with colorglow[IQ] Color Neutralize Conditioner. Then finish with appropriate colorglow[IQ] Color Finish Serum.
